# 无障碍支持 - order: 5 组件内置了部分支持无障碍, 但是额外需要开发者手动事情才能完整支持无障碍：给 Rating 传入一个id，就可以支持语音提示当前选择的评分。注意：如果一个页面上有多个 Rating，id 属性一定不能相同。 :::lang=en-us # Accessibility - order: 5 To Support accessibility, you should assign an id prop to Rating. Notice: Don't assign same id prop for more than one Rating. ::: --- ````jsx import { Rating } from '@alifd/next'; const starMap = { 1: 'Bad', 2: 'OK', 3: 'Good', 4: 'Great', 5: 'Perfect' }; ReactDOM.render(
starMap[val]} onChange={val => console.log('change:', val)} onHoverChange={val => console.log('hover:', val)} />
, mountNode); ````
